p: earth: Meaning, as far as his dominion extended.
his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom: Read Geneva "Da 2:44"
rest in mine house: There was no trouble that might cause me to dream, and therefore it came only from God.
dream which made me afraid: This was another dream besides that which he saw of the four empires, for Daniel both declared what that dream was, and what it meant, and here he expounds this dream.

they did not make known unto: In that he sent abroad to others, whose ignorance in times past he had experienced, and left Daniel who was ever ready at hand, it declares the nature of the ungodly, who never seek for the servants of God unless they absolutely have to, and then they flatter to a great extent.

Belteshazzar: This no doubt was a great grief to Daniel not only to have his name changed, but to be called by the name of a vile idol, which thing Nebuchadnezzar did to make him forget the true religion of God.
master of the magicians: Which also was a great grief to the Prophet, to be numbered among the sorcerers and men whose practices were wicked and contrary to God's word.
tree in the midst of the: By the tree is signified the dignity of a king whom God ordains to be a defence for every type of man, and whose state is profitable for mankind.

watcher and an holy one came: Meaning the angel of God, who neither eats nor sleeps, but is always ready to do God's will, and is not infected with man's corruption, but is always holy. And in that he commands to cut down this tree, he knew that it would not be cut down by man, but by God.
Let his heart be changed from: By this he means that Nebuchadnezzar would not only for a time lose his kingdom, but be like a beast.

This matter is by the decree: God has decreed this judgment and the whole army of heaven has as it were joined in being a part of it, just as they also desire the execution of his decree against all those that lift up themselves against God.

astonied for one hour: He was troubled because of the great judgment of God, which he saw ordained against the king. And so the Prophets on the one hand used to make known God's judgments for the zeal they had for his glory, and on the other hand had compassion upon man. And they also considered that they would be subject to God's judgments, if he did not regard them with pity.
till seven times pass over him: By which he means a long space, as seven years. Some interpret seven months, and others seven weeks, but it seems he means seven years.

oxen: Not that his shape or form was changed into a beast, but that he was either stricken mad, and so avoided man's company, or was cast out because of his tyranny, and so wandered among the beasts, and ate herbs and grass.
the most High ruleth in the: Daniel shows the reason why God punished him in this way.

break off thy sins by righteousness: Cease from provoking God to anger any longer by your sins, that he may reduce the severity of his punishment, if you show by your upright life that you have true faith and repentance.
lengthening of thy tranquillity: Allow the errors of your former life to be made up for.

months he walked in the palace: After Daniel had declared this vision: and this pride of his declares that it is not in man to convert to God, unless his Spirit moves him, seeing that these terrible threatenings could not move him to repent.
days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine: When the term of these seven years was accomplished.

will in the army of heaven: He confesses God's will to be the rule of all justice, and a most perfect law, by which he governs both man and angels and devils, so that none ought to murmur or ask a reason for his doings, but only to stand content with them and give him the glory.
my lords sought unto me: By whom it seems that he had been put from his kingdom before.

praise and extol and honour the: He not only praises God for his deliverance, but also confesses his fault, so that God alone may have the glory, and man the shame, and so that God may be exalted and man cast down.
